title: Local homogeneous generators give an explicit algebra-module epimorphism
statement: Let A,B be commutative rings with B an A-algebra and let B_k be any A-submodules of B. Let pi:Y -> X and f_B:Y -> Spec B be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and G_m sheaves of O_X-modules with O_X-linear maps mu_m,k(b):G_m -> G_(m+k) for b in B_k [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix an open U of X, r >= 0, degrees d_i and sections s_i in G_(d_i)(U), indexed by Fin r. Suppose that for every m, open V contained in U, section t of G_m on V and point y in V, there is W containing y and contained in V where t restricts to the O_X(W)-span of mu_(d_i,m-d_i)(b)(s_i|W), for d_i <= m and b in B_(m-d_i), identifying G_(d_i+(m-d_i)) with G_m. Let F be any O_Y-module. Suppose maps iota_m:G_m -> pi_*F exhibit the latter as their coproduct [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and satisfy iota_(m+k) composed with mu_m,k(b) = multiplication by f_B^sharp(b) composed with iota_m. Set Acal=pi_*O_Y and let M=pi_*F with its sectionwise Acal-action. Then the map from the free Acal|U-module with basis ULift(Fin r) to M|U, sending basis i to iota_(d_i)(s_i) and restricting this section to every smaller open, is an epimorphism [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. No affineness or quasi-coherence is assumed.

proof.text: For algebra-linear maps p,q out of M|U agreeing after the finite free map, the free-Hom equivalence shows equality on every restriction of each iota_(d_i)(s_i). Mathlib SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_comp_apply computes these images.

Restriction to the slice over U is a left adjoint in Mathlib (SheafOfModules.isLeftAdjoint_pushforward_of_isIso, specialized to Over.forget). Hence isColimitOfPreserves transports the given coproduct to U. Restrict scalars from the direct-image algebra to O_X and use coproduct hom_ext to reduce equality of p,q to each G_m.

For t on V contained in U and y in V, choose W by the local spanning hypothesis. Induct using Submodule.span_induction. In the generator case d_i+(m-d_i)=m resolves the HEq. Compatibility and Scheme.Modules.smulHom_app_apply identify its image with multiplication by the restriction of fB^sharp(b). Algebra-linearity of p,q and equality on the basis section prove equality on this multiple; O_X-linearity handles scalar multiples, addition, and zero.

The equalizer sieve of the two images of t is covering: for every y the preceding W belongs to it. Mathlib GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff and Sieve.overEquiv_iff identify this covering on the slice site. Sheaf separatedness gives equality on V. Coproduct uniqueness then gives equality after scalar restriction, and equality of the underlying component functions gives p=q. Empty families and empty opens satisfy the same proof without additional hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem gradedRealization_local_generators_epi
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (graded : ℕ → Submodule A B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (pi : Y ⟶ X) (fB : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B))
    (G : ℕ → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (mu : ∀ (m k : ℕ), graded k → (G m ⟶ G (m + k)))
    (U : X.Opens) (r : ℕ) (d : Fin r → ℕ)
    (s : ∀ i : Fin r, (G (d i)).val.obj (op U))
    (hgen : ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (t : (G m).val.obj (op V))
      (y : X), y ∈ V → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧
        (G m).val.map (homOfLE hWV).op t ∈
          Submodule.span ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op W))
            {z | ∃ (i : Fin r), d i ≤ m ∧
              ∃ b : graded (m - d i),
                HEq z ((mu (d i) (m - d i) b).val.app (op W)
                  ((G (d i)).val.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).op (s i)))})
    (F : Y.Modules)
    (iota : ∀ m : ℕ, G m ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F)
    (hcoprod : Nonempty (IsColimit
      (Cofan.mk ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F) iota)))
    (hcompat : ∀ (k m : ℕ) (b : graded k),
      mu m k b ≫ iota (m + k) = iota m ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).map
          (F.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫ fB.appTop).hom b.val))) :
    let AR := (sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} pi.base).obj Y.sheaf)
    let M := (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (F := TopologicalSpace.Opens.map pi.base)
      (S := AR) (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (𝟙 AR)).obj F
    let a : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → (M.over U).sections := fun i ↦
      PresheafOfModules.sectionsMk
        (fun V ↦ M.val.presheaf.map V.unop.hom.op ((iota (d i.down)).val.app (op U) (s i.down)))
        (fun V W v ↦ by
          change M.val.presheaf.map v.unop.left.op _ = _
          rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
          rfl)
    Epi ((M.over U).freeHomEquiv.symm a)
